clearanceEvaluationRules.statement: Clearance between Body A and Body B MUST be computed from their actual canonical surface meshes or solid B-Reps.
clearanceEvaluationRules.invariant: Two bodies with identical centroids but different geometry (e.g. 500mm blade vs 1mm screw) MUST produce distinct clearance values reflecting their true boundaries.

clearanceEvaluationRules.statement: All occurrences of 'centerDist - constant' (e.g. centerDist - 30.0) are strictly deprecated and prohibited in authoritative clearance calculations.

semanticDistinctions.COLLISION: Volumetric overlap between non-cutting components (e.g. Holder vs Part, Cutter Shank vs Fixture).
semanticDistinctions.GOUGE: Excess material removal where the active cutter envelope penetrates beyond the finished part design surface by more than the specified machining tolerance (e.g. tolerance = 0.020mm).
semanticDistinctions.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION: Minimum Euclidean distance between safe non-cutting surfaces is less than the required clearance margin (e.g. clearance < 2.0mm) without physical interpenetration.
semanticDistinctions.INTENDED_CUT: Cutter flute intersecting raw stock or machining allowance within nominal toolpath tolerances.
